chatCalls_audioRoomContractAudioRoomRest.en: Reconnected. Tap the mic to keep speaking
chatCalls_audioRoomContractAudioRoomRest.zh: 已重新连接，点麦克风继续发言

chatCalls_audioRoomContractDisconnected.en: Voice disconnected; count updates after reconnecting
chatCalls_audioRoomContractDisconnected.zh: 语音已断开，人数以重新连接后为准

chatCalls_audioRoomContractReconnecting.en: Voice reconnecting; count updates after reconnecting
chatCalls_audioRoomContractReconnecting.zh: 语音正在重连，人数以重新连接后为准

chatCalls_audioRoomContractText.en: Tap to return to the voice room

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewCallClosed.en: You can't speak in this call anymore. Leave and join again.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewCallClosed.zh: 这次通话已经不能再发言了，请退出后重新进入。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewCanRequest.zh: 此刻在通话里的人数正在统计

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewCommandErr.zh: 语音没能重新接上，请再试一次。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewCommandErr.en: Couldn't leave this call cleanly. Retry.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewCommandErr.zh: 这次通话没能干净地退出，请重试。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf.en: Leaving this call. The mic won't start again; mute first if needed, then retry leaving.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf.zh: 正在退出这次通话。麦克风不会再启动；如有需要先静音，再重试退出。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf2.en: Your mic is on and people in the room can hear you. Tap Mute to turn it off anytime.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf2.zh: 你的麦克风已打开，房间里的人能听到你。点「静音」随时关掉。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf3.en: You were moved off stage and can only listen now. Wait for the host to invite you again to speak.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf3.zh: 你已被移出发言席，现在只能收听。要再发言，请等主持人重新邀请。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf4.en: You're muted. To speak again, tap {speakAgainLabel} to reconnect voice.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf4.zh: 你已静音。要再次发言，点「{speakAgainLabel}」把这次语音重新接一遍。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf5.en: You joined muted. Tap {speakLabel} when you're ready; mic access is only requested when capture starts.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewIf5.zh: 你以静音状态进入。准备好后点「{speakLabel}」，系统麦克风权限只在开始采集时申请。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage.en: This call dropped and is reconnecting. Member details reload once connected.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage.zh: 这次通话掉线了，正在自动接回来。成员明细会在连上后重新读出。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage2.en: This call disconnected. Member details load after voice reconnects.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage2.zh: 这次通话已经断开，成员明细要重新连接语音之后才能读出。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage3.en: Not connected to this call yet. Member details load once connected.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage3.zh: 还没有连上这次通话，成员明细会在连上后读出。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage4.en: This call just connected; the provider hasn't sent member details yet.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewMessage4.zh: 这次通话刚连上，服务商还没有给出成员明细。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewRoomPermis.en: This room hasn't let you speak yet; your mic is off.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewRoomPermis.zh: 这个房间还没有让你发言，麦克风没有打开。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewS.en: {count, plural, =1{1 person in the call now} other{{count} people in the call now}}

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewS2.en: You're a listener in this room.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewS2.zh: 你在这个房间是只收听的角色。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewSetState.en: Couldn't mute the mic. Retry, or leave this room.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewSetState.zh: 麦克风没能静音。请重试，或退出这个房间。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewSwitch.en: Audio plays from the connected device
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewSwitch.zh: 声音从已连接的设备输出

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewSystemPerm.en: No mic access. Allow LOOP to use the microphone in system settings, then try again.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewSystemPerm.zh: 没有麦克风权限，去系统设置里允许 LOOP 使用麦克风后再试。

chatCalls_streamForegroundViewUnknown.en: Couldn't turn on the mic. Try again.
chatCalls_streamForegroundViewUnknown.zh: 麦克风没能打开，请再试一次。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomAccountChanged.en: Your sign-in changed while connecting. Leave this page and come back.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomAccountChanged.zh: 登录状态在连接过程中发生了变化。请退出这一页再进来。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomClient.en: Couldn't set up voice on this device. Try again.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomClient.zh: 语音连接没能在这台设备上建立。请重试一次。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomConnection.en: This device couldn't reach the voice service. Check your network and retry.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomConnection.zh: 这台设备没能连上语音服务。请检查网络后重试。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomCredential.en: The voice credential for this call wasn't issued. Check your network and retry.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomCredential.zh: 这次通话的语音凭证没有发下来。请检查网络后重试。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomHost.en: You're the host and also join muted; mic access is only requested when you tap {speakLabel}. The room doesn't end if voice can't connect; use End room below to end it.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomHost.zh: 你是主持人，进入时同样静音，点「{speakLabel}」才会申请麦克风权限；语音没连上房间也不会结束，要结束请用下面的「结束房间」。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomIdentity.en: This device doesn't have a voice identity yet. Leave this page and come back.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomIdentity.zh: 这台设备还没有拿到语音身份。请退出这一页再进来。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomIf.en: You always join muted; mic access is only requested when you tap Speak. Voice continues in the background or when locked; only Leave disconnects.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomIf.zh: 始终静音进入；系统麦克风权限只在你点「发言」时申请。切到后台或锁屏后语音继续，点「离开」才会断开。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomIf2.zh: 静音进入 · 后台继续

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomIf3.en: No demo members, presence or room activity are shown here.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomIf3.zh: 这里不展示演示成员、在线状态或房间动态。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomJoinError.en: Couldn't get this voice room ready. Check the conversation and retry.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomJoinError.zh: 这个语音房没能准备好，请检查会话后重试。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage.en: This call disconnected. Recording your exit in the LOOP room record.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage.zh: 这次通话已经断开，正在把离开记到 LOOP 的房间记录里。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage10.en: Requesting a voice identity and short-lived token. No call is joined meanwhile.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage10.zh: 正在向后端申请语音身份与短时令牌。期间不会加入任何通话。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage11.en: Loading the authorized voice room. Your mic stays off.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage11.zh: 正在读取后端已授权的语音房。麦克风保持关闭。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage12.en: Couldn't load the authorized voice room. No other room is joined and no demo data is shown instead.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage12.zh: 已授权的语音房读取失败，不会改连其他房间，也不会用演示数据顶替。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage13.en: This session doesn't have an authorized voice room yet. Enter from a community's voice room.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage13.zh: 这次会话还没有拿到已授权的语音房，请从社区的语音房入口进入。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage14.en: The voice room is authorized, but the voice client for this account has expired. Re-authorize the session.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage14.zh: 语音房已授权，但绑定当前账号的语音客户端已经失效，请重新授权会话。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage15.en: Voice room authorized. You always join muted, and voice continues in the background.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage15.zh: 已拿到后端授权的语音房。始终静音进入，切到后台后语音继续。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage16.en: No local audio is published while connecting.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage16.zh: 连接过程中不会发布任何本地音频。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage17.en: Mic access is only requested after you tap Speak.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage17.zh: 系统麦克风权限只在你点「发言」之后才申请。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage18.en: Voice continues when you switch apps or lock the screen; only Leave disconnects.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage18.zh: 切到其他 App 或锁屏后语音继续，只有「离开」才会断开。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage2.en: You're still in the room and will reconnect automatically when the network is back. Use Leave below to exit.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage2.zh: 网络恢复后会自动接回这个房间，你仍然在房间里。要退出请用下面的「离开」。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage3.en: Reloading this room and getting a new voice identity, then reconnecting.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage3.zh: 正在重新读取这个房间并重新取得语音身份，然后再连接一次。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage4.en: {joinError}You're still in this room and haven't been removed.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage4.zh: {joinError}你仍然在这个房间里，没有被移出。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage5.en: This call disconnected. LOOP still lists you as a member of this room.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage5.zh: 这次通话已经断开，你在 LOOP 记录里仍然是这个房间的成员。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage6.en: Joined the room, connecting voice. You joined muted as a listener.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage6.zh: 已经加入房间，正在建立语音连接。你以听众身份静音进入。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage7.en: Voice only starts in a verified sign-in session; offline or unverified sessions don't connect.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage7.zh: 语音只在完成验证的登录会话里启动；离线或未验证的会话不会连接。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage8.en: Can't connect again until the last call has turned off the mic and left.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage8.zh: 在确认上一次通话已关闭麦克风并退出之前，不能再次连接。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage9.en: The last call didn't confirm leaving. Retry cleanup first, then connect voice.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomMessage9.zh: 上一次通话没有确认退出。请先重试收尾，再连接语音。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomNetwork.en: This connection didn't go through. Check your network and retry.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomNetwork.zh: 这次连接没有接通，请检查网络后重试。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomPermission.en: Listening isn't open in this room yet. Ask the host to reopen it.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomPermission.zh: 这个房间还没有开放收听，请让主持人重新开启。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomRoomUnavailable.en: This room can't be joined anymore. Check the community to see if it's still live.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomRoomUnavailable.zh: 这个房间已经不能加入了，请回到社区看它是否还在进行。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSession.en: This voice identity has expired. Leave this page and come back.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSession.zh: 这次的语音身份已经失效，请退出这一页再进来。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSpeaker.en: You're a speaker and also join muted; mic access is only requested when you tap {speakLabel}. Voice isn't connected but you're still in the room; tap Leave below to exit.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSpeaker.zh: 你是发言人，进入时同样静音，点「{speakLabel}」才会申请麦克风权限；语音没连上，你仍在房间里；要退出请点下面的「离开」。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSwitch.en: This device couldn't set up a voice session. It stays disconnected and no call is created.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSwitch.zh: 这台设备没能建立语音会话。这里保持断开，不会创建任何通话。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSwitch2.en: You joined muted as a listener and mic access isn't requested. Voice isn't connected but you're still in the room; tap Leave below to exit.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomSwitch2.zh: 你以听众身份静音进入，不会申请麦克风权限；语音没连上，你仍在房间里；要退出请点下面的「离开」。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomTitle2.zh: 语音连接中断，正在自动重连

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomTitle6.zh: 正在确认上一次通话的收尾

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomTitle7.en: The last call didn't end cleanly

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomUnknown.en: Couldn't connect to this voice room. Try again later.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomUnknown.zh: 没能连上这个语音房，请稍后重试。

chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomVoiceroomMediaR.en: Your mic was on when the network dropped. It stays muted after reconnecting; tap {vVoiceMediaPresentation} when you need it.
chatCalls_streamVoiceRoomVoiceroomMediaR.zh: 网络断开时你的麦克风是开着的。重新连接后保持静音，需要时再点「{vVoiceMediaPresentation}」。
